segments.en: Today I practise 计算机英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 错误与调试 with a teammate. I use bug to talk about 程序缺陷，使程序出现错误行为的问题. I use error message to talk about 错误信息，说明程序为何失败的提示. I use debugging to talk about 调试，寻找并修复程序问题的过程. I tell my teammate: Today I use bug, error message, and debugging. At the end, I say: I can use bug clearly today.

At the end, I say: I can use reproduce an error clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise 日常交流英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 问路和交通 with a teammate. I use How do I get to ...? to talk about 我怎么去……？. I use Is it far from here? to talk about 离这里远吗？. I use Turn left. to talk about 向左转。. I tell my teammate: Today I use How do I get to ...?, Is it far from here?, and Turn left.. At the end, I say: I can use How do I get to ...? clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise 日常交流英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about 问路和交通 with a teammate. I use Go straight. to talk about 一直向前走。. I use Which line should I take? to talk about 我应该坐哪条线路？. I use Where should I get off? to talk about 我应该在哪里下车？. I tell my teammate: Today I use Go straight., Which line should I take?, and Where should I get off?. At the end, I say: I can use Go straight. clearly today.

segments.en: Today I practise github 项目英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about issue 问题单 with a teammate. I use issue to talk about 问题单，用来记录缺陷、需求或讨论事项. I use open an issue to talk about 创建问题单，开始记录一个待处理事项. I use issue title to talk about 问题单标题，用一句话概括问题. I tell my teammate: Today I use issue, open an issue, and issue title. At the end, I say: I can use issue clearly today.

segments.zh: 今天口语练习围绕“GitHub 项目英语”，场景是“Issue 问题单”。先听英文，再尝试不看中文复述。issue：问题单，用来记录缺陷、需求或讨论事项。示例：Our team uses "issue" to keep the project clear.open an issue：创建问题单，开始记录一个待处理事项。示例：Our team uses "open an issue" to keep the project clear.issue title：问题单标题，用一句话概括问题。示例：Our team uses "issue title" to keep the project clear.最后用自己的经历替换示例中的内容，再说一遍。

segments.en: Today I practise github 项目英语 in a real work conversation. The situation is simple: I need to talk about issue 问题单 with a teammate. I use issue description to talk about 问题单描述，提供背景、现象和目标. I use bug report to talk about 缺陷报告，详细记录软件错误. I use close an issue to talk about 关闭问题单，表示事项已经解决或不再处理. I tell my teammate: Today I use issue description, bug report, and close an issue. At the end, I say: I can use issue description clearly today.
